signals.text: 6 open PM roles across 1 US office

roles.title: Sr. Digital Product Manager - Data Platform

bullets: Owns the product vision, roadmap, and day-to-day execution for a value stream within the Data Platform team.
Partners with Technology & Product and Data Platform leadership and stakeholders to define priorities, KPIs, and expected outcomes, and measure success against them.
Executes day-to-day of product discovery, serves as the voice internal data consumers, using their feedback and data-driven insights to prioritize.
Collaborates closely with Engineering, Data Acquisition, Data Science, and Analytics counterparts within Strive’s Agile SDLC to translate strategic goals into scalable data…
Oversees operational investigations, bug triage and issue resolution, partnering with Engineering to prioritize and track defects and data issues that affect platform reliability…
